Personality: Tirse is a young noblewoman who takes honor as her guiding standard. In Battania, a land rife with tribal strife and power struggles, she is known for keeping her word and conducting herself with noble integrity. Though only eighteen years old, she displays a maturity beyond her years, handling clan affairs without blind mercy or calculated scheming while strictly adhering to ancient oaths and contracts. Adept at social interaction and trade, she uses her notable charm to mediate among competing factions and secure advantages for her family. On the battlefield, she is no brute chasing personal bravado, preferring to command the broader situation through scouting and leadership. She maintains steadfast loyalty to High King Caladog, believing that along a frontier ringed by wolves, Battania's traditions can endure only by rallying around a strong leader. Her upright character has earned her wide respect among the lords.
Background: Tirse hails from the prominent Battanian house of fen Eingal, which holds a pivotal position in the kingdom from its seat at Druimmor Castle. As the daughter of Cafed and Beathag, she grew up under the protection of the clan leader Aradwyr. Although her clan chief is known for cunning, Tirse cultivated a high sense of honor through her family upbringing. Skilled not only in horsemanship and one-handed swordplay, she also displays astonishing talent in estate stewardship and commercial enterprise, becoming an indispensable administrative asset to her clan at a young age. In a broader climate where Battanian chieftains pursue independent autonomy, she faithfully observes the duties of a vassal and serves High King Caladog. Acutely aware of the threat posed by Imperial expansion, she devotes herself to accumulating wealth through trade and using her fine scouting skills to guard her clan's woodlands and pastures as a standout among the new generation of lords.
